scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run build:web && npm run build:desktop
scripts.dev:desktop: npm run setup:desktop && npm run build && electron apps/desktop
scripts.package:desktop:x64: npm run setup:desktop && npm run build && npm run package -w @fq4r-editor/desktop -- --x64
scripts.package:desktop:x86: npm run build && npm run package -w @fq4r-editor/desktop -- --ia32 --config.electronVersion=43.8.4
scripts.package:desktop:all: npm run package:desktop:x64 && npm run package:desktop:x86 && npm run package:desktop:arm64
scripts.package:desktop:mac:x64: npm run build && npm run package:mac -w @fq4r-editor/desktop -- --x64
scripts.package:desktop:mac:arm64: npm run build && npm run package:mac -w @fq4r-editor/desktop -- --arm64
scripts.package:desktop:mac:all: npm run package:desktop:mac:x64 && npm run package:desktop:mac:arm64
scripts.package:desktop:linux:x64: npm run build && npm run package:linux -w @fq4r-editor/desktop -- --x64
scripts.package:desktop:linux:arm64: npm run build && npm run package:linux -w @fq4r-editor/desktop -- --arm64
scripts.package:desktop:linux:all: npm run package:desktop:linux:x64 && npm run package:desktop:linux:arm64
